units.rawText: Actually, I'm really grateful to you, Professor.
units.displayText: Actually, I'm really grateful to you, Professor.

spans.text: Actually, I'm really grateful to you, Professor.

units.rawText: Before coming to the Oasis, all we could do was drift along and avoid the Sanctifiers. We were hard-pressed to protect ourselves, let alone stay clean.
units.displayText: Before coming to the Oasis, all we could do was drift along and avoid the Sanctifiers. We were hard-pressed to protect ourselves, let alone stay clean.

spans.text: Before coming to the Oasis, all we could do was drift along and avoid the Sanctifiers. We were hard-pressed to protect ourselves, let alone stay clean.

units.rawText: You were the one who gave me a place where I could devote my efforts to keeping things clean.
units.displayText: You were the one who gave me a place where I could devote my efforts to keeping things clean.

spans.text: You were the one who gave me a place where I could devote my efforts to keeping things clean.

units.rawText: I like how happy everyone looks after I clean a room up all spick and span.
units.displayText: I like how happy everyone looks after I clean a room up all spick and span.

spans.text: I like how happy everyone looks after I clean a room up all spick and span.

units.rawText: It's a completely different feeling from how I felt about finishing a job before coming to the cloud server. In the words of the maintenance techs, it probably has nothing to do with my base layer code.

units.displayText: It's chocolate...

units.rawText: Although it isn't as well made as Choco's and the others and it caused the kitchen to need extra cleaning, I still hope that you'll accept it, Professor.
